dateline: DAY 4311 — JULY 2026 — CNDH RECOMMENDATION SPARKS NEW CRISIS
heroHeadline: CNDH Exonerates Army in Ayotzinapa Case; Encinas Reveals Contradicting Military Documents
heroSubtitle: A CNDH recommendation on July 9 cleared the Army of institutional responsibility, drawing sharp criticism from families, Amnesty International, and the UN. Days later, former Truth Commission head Alejandro Encinas released SEDENA documents alleging one of the 43 was an embedded military intelligence asset — contradicting the CNDH's own findings. President Sheinbaum distanced her government from the report and ordered a review. GIEI's return was ruled out in May, and June saw fresh detentions in the disputed Iguala funeral-home line and a police blockade of families en route to the 141st monthly Global Action.
footerNote: Data compiled from GIEI reports (I–VI), Mexican Truth Commission, CNDH Recommendation 208VG/2026, EAAF forensic reports, IACHR/OHCHR statements, and investigative journalism (Proceso, Infobae, La Jornada, Tlachinollan). All contested claims are marked.
